front.title: BGP SR Policy for Path Rate

abstract.t: In AI/ML compute fabrics and data center interconnects, collective communication patterns (e.g., All-Reduce, All-to-All) generate microbursts that can saturate queuing buffers before reactive congestion control mechanisms take effect. This document specifies a BGP SR Policy extension to carry Path Rate information (e.g., Path Committed Rate and Path Maximum Rate), enabling a central controller to compute and distribute per-segment-list rate limits along with the SR Policy Candidate Path. The headend enforces these rate limits on traffic steered to the corresponding segment list, thereby proactively preventing the microburst-induced congestion before traffic enters the network.
